abilities.description: Diagnoses and repairs solar-powered cooling and water systems using salvaged components and technical records.
abilities.name: Solar systems repair

abilities.description: Compares sensor readings and surface conditions to identify where the weather satellite's heat estimates may be misleading.
abilities.name: Heat-pattern analysis

characters.arc: Mira begins certain that a fast, technically precise solution is worth any compromise. When the Quiet Vault's living root seal requires a measured balance of warmth and moisture, she must follow botanist Ilyan's judgment instead of forcing an opening. She ends by helping build a seed corridor with Reedline and the Canopy Keepers, accepting that protecting Westglass depends on knowledge and resources being shared.
characters.description: Mira is a young engineer raised among the terraced reservoirs and solar mirrors of Westglass Greenhold. She learned to maintain cooling pumps by watching repair crews work, then earned a place on the systems team by diagnosing faults others had dismissed as ordinary wear. The failing network and the satellite's shifting heat patterns have left her convinced that the right technical fix can solve any emergency. She is lean and quick-moving, with close-cropped dark hair, a sun-faded work jacket, and a belt of carefully labeled tools.
characters.external_conflict: The failing cooling network gives her little time to cross the Glass Waste, while the Lattice Council's focus on Westglass repairs clashes with the Canopy Keepers' demand for fair seed distribution.
characters.flaw: She treats expertise as a reason to make decisions alone and dismisses knowledge she cannot measure.
characters.goal: Reach the Quiet Vault, learn how its flowering plants can confuse the satellite's heat readings, and help establish a seed corridor that can protect Westglass.
characters.internal_conflict: Mira wants to protect her home immediately, but fears that sharing scarce resources beyond Westglass will make her responsible if its cooling system fails.
characters.motivation: Keep Westglass's people safe without letting its gardens and shared systems become expendable.
characters.name: Mira Sol

abilities.description: Recognizes hardy plants and tends living collections with careful attention to their water and growing conditions.
abilities.name: Plant stewardship

abilities.description: Understands how to introduce warmth and moisture gradually to avoid harming the Quiet Vault's living entrance.
abilities.name: Root-seal care

characters.arc: Ilyan begins guarding the vault's location and plans so tightly that even allies must work around his silences. When the satellite's heat threat makes secrecy a danger to Westglass and Reedline alike, he entrusts Mira with the vault's location and explains how the root seal responds to warmth and moisture. He ends by opening the vault alongside the others and committing to a distribution plan that makes his knowledge useful beyond his own control.
characters.description: Ilyan is a reclusive botanist who has spent years tending surviving plant collections and studying the routes by which hardy species persist in the Wastes. He found traces of the Quiet Vault beneath an abandoned agricultural station but kept its location secret until he could imagine a plan that would protect its seeds and distribute them beyond the Greenholds. He is tall and spare, with weather-darkened skin, a loose sun hood, and seed pouches stitched into the lining of his travel clothes. His quiet manner can make his care look like indifference.
characters.external_conflict: The approaching heat event makes delay dangerous, while the vault's root seal can be harmed by a rushed attempt and the Lattice Council wants its resources directed first toward Westglass.
characters.flaw: He withholds information to protect his principles, leaving others unable to help or make informed choices.
characters.goal: Open the Quiet Vault without damaging its living seal and secure a fair plan for sharing its seeds.
characters.internal_conflict: Ilyan fears that revealing the vault will let powerful groups claim its contents, yet keeping its location secret may deny people the very seeds he wants to share.
characters.motivation: Preserve living knowledge and make sure the seeds can help settlements beyond the arcologies, not only the people with the most power.
characters.name: Ilyan Ves

abilities.description: Navigates the Glass Waste by reading scrub patches, terrain, and changing conditions while conserving water.
abilities.name: Waste routefinding

abilities.description: Memorizes and updates route songs that preserve reliable paths as springs and old roads change.
abilities.name: Oral mapping

abilities.description: Sets clear terms for exchanging local knowledge and labor with outsiders.
abilities.name: Negotiation

characters.arc: Sela begins by refusing to give the travelers the Wayfinders' safer route until they accept Reedline's terms. When the approaching heat event threatens both Westglass and the routes Reedline depends on, she chooses to guide them after Mira and Ilyan agree to share their findings and include Reedline in the seed plan. She ends as a partner who still protects local knowledge but no longer treats cooperation as surrender.
characters.description: Sela is a guide and seed keeper from Reedline, raised around its brackish spring and reed maze. She learned the settlement's oral route songs from relatives and now updates them when springs shift or old paths vanish. Greenhold expeditions have often treated local knowledge as a resource to collect, so she is careful about what she shares and insists that visitors contribute. She has a wiry build, a reed-fiber pack, and a strip of dyed cloth around one wrist marked with route notches.
characters.external_conflict: The Lattice Council's mission needs a safe crossing through the Glass Waste, but the Wayfinders will not reveal their route without an agreement that respects Reedline's independence.
characters.flaw: Her distrust makes her turn every offer of help into a test, even when time is running out.
characters.goal: Guide Mira and Ilyan safely across the Glass Waste only after they agree to share useful information and include Reedline in decisions about the seed corridor.
characters.internal_conflict: Sela wants Reedline to remain self-determining, but keeping its route knowledge separate may leave its people exposed to the same threat endangering Westglass.
characters.motivation: Protect Reedline's independence and ensure its knowledge is respected rather than taken.
characters.name: Sela Reed

abilities.description: Organizes repair priorities and tracks shared power, water, and equipment needs across Greenholds.
abilities.name: Resource coordination

abilities.description: Builds practical response plans under time pressure and identifies which system failures put residents at immediate risk.
abilities.name: Crisis planning

characters.arc: Oren begins determined to secure the Quiet Vault's resources for Westglass before anyone can dilute the emergency response. When Mira returns with evidence that flowering plants can mislead the satellite and that Reedline's route knowledge made the expedition possible, he must choose whether to withhold that plan or put it before the Council. He ends by supporting a shared seed-corridor effort alongside urgent Westglass repairs, accepting that stability requires cooperation rather than exclusive control.
characters.description: Oren is a Lattice Council delegate from Westglass who coordinates repair priorities between the arcology and neighboring Greenholds. He has spent years making difficult choices about power, water, and scarce replacement parts, and he believes that clear priorities prevent panic. The satellite's new track has made him more rigid: he sees every hour spent on the vault as an hour taken from Westglass's failing cooling system. He is broad-shouldered, wears a plain council sash over a patched work coat, and keeps careful handwritten tallies in a weatherproof folio.
characters.external_conflict: The Canopy Keepers oppose directing the vault's resources only to Westglass, and the satellite's approaching heat event leaves too little time for the Council to settle the dispute by ordinary deliberation.
characters.flaw: He mistakes control over allocation for control over outcomes and discounts the risks of excluding others.
characters.goal: Direct the first usable vault resources and technical knowledge toward Westglass's emergency repairs.
characters.internal_conflict: Oren believes responsible leadership requires putting Westglass first, but he knows the Greenholds depend on shared repairs and cannot endure indefinitely by taking more than they give.
characters.motivation: Prevent Westglass from losing the cooling system that protects its residents.
characters.name: Oren Dask

relationships.description: Mira and Ilyan are uneasy allies: Mira needs his botanical knowledge to approach the vault safely, while he challenges her habit of treating engineering urgency as permission to decide alone.
Ilyan distrusts Mira's instinct to prioritize Westglass's systems over fair seed distribution, and his secrecy frustrates her when every delay threatens the cooling network.
Sela agrees to guide Mira across the Glass Waste only after Mira accepts that Reedline's route knowledge must be exchanged by agreement, not simply claimed for the Council.
Oren wants the Quiet Vault's resources directed first to Westglass, while Ilyan insists they be protected and shared with settlements beyond the Greenholds.

Oren helped Mira learn how Greenhold repair priorities are coordinated, but their bond is strained when his emergency-first policy conflicts with her growing belief that shared knowledge can protect Westglass.
